body: The PR links issue #3904, but the issue has no priority label. Please give issue #3904 the right P label (P1-P9). The PR carries the label of the issue from the sweep.

Safety checks and input mutations:
The drawn neck affects stack checks and simulation, so this review includes the safety checks.
I reran `a_cutter_that_disagrees_refuses_the_file_by_tool_name` alone with `--exact`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
That test applies two input mutations from this PR:
1. Change the flute radius from 5 mm to 6 mm on a diameter-10 tool. The reader refuses it by tool name.
2. Replace the points with `"not points"`. The reader refuses the malformed definition by tool name.
Both mutated inputs were refused; the test stayed green. These are input mutations, not source-code mutations.
The normal round trip and Update/undo/redo controls also passed in the tool_library suite.
No source code was changed for this review. No full heavy lane ran.

Requested before merge:

1. **Class: issue labels.** `AGENTS.md:132` and `AGENTS.md:231` on upstream/main require issue triage labels.
   Issue #3904 still has no labels. [NeoTech's request](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3906#issuecomment-7136429312) is not met.
   A collaborator must complete the issue labels: exactly one P1-P9 priority, one effort label, the area label, and `source:agent`.
   `P3` fits the reported incorrect behavior with a project-file workaround. The PR declares `effort:high`.
   Apply the labels to the issue; a body statement does not replace a label.
   The reviewer role permits only PR review-label changes, so this review does not change the issue labels.

No code blocker was found. The PR is MERGEABLE, but the unmet maintainer request requires `needs-rework`.
The review worktree and its build cache remain in place.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Reply to the review of 4592f2e2b (issue labels).

The account that filed #3904 (qsmits) is not a collaborator, so it cannot set labels. There is no code change to make for this finding. A collaborator: please set these labels on #3904:

- P3 (the reviewer's proposal: incorrect behaviour with a project-file workaround), or P4 like the parent #3663.
- effort:high
- the area label (area:tools or area:ui, as you use them)
- source:agent

The same applies to the other new issues of the tool library plan: #3892 to #3898, #3908. Their bodies ask for labels too.

## The change request is still open

The only review marker on this head (`4592f2e2b`, 15:52:43Z) is a **needs changes** verdict. The reviewer set `needs-rework`.

The label was removed at 20:27:43Z without a review on the head and without a withdrawal comment by the reviewer.

The rule: a review that asks for a change stays open until the reviewer withdraws it in a comment, or a new head gets a clean review. The author's reply is about labels outside the code: the finding was that #3904 carried no priority label. #3904 now reads P3, effort:high, bug and area:sim, so the finding looks met.

Reviewer: please re-read the replies and withdraw in a comment (or review the head again). Until then this PR is not merge-ready, whatever its labels say.
